# PlinkMatrix: DelayedArray interface for plink genotypes

Given a collection of .bed, .bim and .fam files produced for use with
Plink, this package facilitates simple array-like operations for
retrieving genotype data.

![NEW!](https://img.shields.io/badge/NEW!-black?style=flat-square&labelColor=yellow&color=yellow)
learnr tutorials on SVD illustrated with human SNPs!

- be sure learnr and shiny are installed
- [`PlinkMatrix_tutorials()`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/PlinkMatrix_tutorials.md)
  starts a simple menu interface

![](reference/figures/intf1.jpg)

- eventually gets to

![](reference/figures/tut1.jpg)

## Installation

Use Bioconductor 3.23.

    BiocManager::install("PlinkMatrix")

## Example

As an example, the GEUVADIS study genotypes distributed with tensorQTL
were transformed to `geuv445.{bed,bim,fam}`. In a folder containing
these files, we would proceed as follows to interrogate the genotypes.

    > library(PlinkMatrix)
    > gdemo = example_PlinkMatrix()
    > colnames(gdemo) = gsub("0_", "", colnames(gdemo))
    > gdemo
    <367759 x 445> DelayedMatrix object of type "double":
                            HG00096 HG00097 HG00099 ... NA20826 NA20828
        chr18_10644_C_G_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
        chr18_10847_C_A_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
        chr18_11275_G_A_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
        chr18_11358_G_A_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
        chr18_11445_G_A_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
                        ...       .       .       .   .       .       .
    chr18_80259028_AG_A_b38       1       2       2   .       0       1
     chr18_80259147_G_C_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
     chr18_80259181_A_G_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0
       chr18_8025919C_G_b38       1       0       0   .       1       0
     chr18_80259245_C_A_b38       0       0       0   .       0       0

The associated data can be obtained in this package with
[`example_PlinkMatrix()`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/example_PlinkMatrix.md).

See “Get started” tab above for more information.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`PlinkMatrix-pkg`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/PlinkMatrix-pkg.md)
  : Delayed interface to Plink genotype files
- [`PlinkMatrix()`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/PlinkMatrix.md)
  : Constructor for DelayedArray
- [`PlinkMatrix_tutorials()`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/PlinkMatrix_tutorials.md)
  : browse and launch the learnr tutorials bundled with PlinkMatrix
- [`dim(`*`<PlinkSeed>`*`)`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/dim-PlinkSeed-method.md)
  : Method: dim for delayed plink
- [`dimnames(`*`<PlinkSeed>`*`)`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/dimnames-PlinkSeed-method.md)
  : Method: dimnames for delayed plink
- [`example_GRanges`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/example_GRanges.md)
  : sample GRanges coordinated with example_PlinkMatrix
- [`example_PlinkMatrix()`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/example_PlinkMatrix.md)
  : produce PlinkMatrix from example data
- [`g445samples`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/g445samples.md)
  : sample characteristics of 445 GEUVADIS samples
- [`getSampleData()`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/getSampleData.md)
  : Get sample metadata
- [`getVariantData()`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/getVariantData.md)
  : Get variant metadata
- [`get_plink_example_path()`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/get_plink_example_path.md)
  : operate with BiocFileCache to retrieve zip file of plink example
  data
- [`plid2gr()`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/plid2gr.md)
  : produce GRanges from variant notation for plink example from
  geuvadis
- [`read_bed_subset()`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/read_bed_subset.md)
  : read subset for use in delayed matrix approach
- [`show(`*`<PlinkSeed>`*`)`](https://github.com/vjcitn/PlinkMatrix/reference/show-PlinkSeed-method.md)
  : present seed concisely
